name: Contentsquare
description: Quickly understand everything your users are doing and why, directly from Claude. Contentsquare automatically captures every user action and analyzes it retroactively, no tagging needed. Ask Claude natural language questions about your analytics.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Contentsquare to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Contentsquare to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.contentsquare.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Contentsquare MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contentsquare lists 21 MCP tools, including submitMcpFeedback, computeSiteMetrics, getTopErrorsBySessionsWithErrors, getTopErrorsByImpactOnGoal, getTopErrorsByMissedOpportunity, getTopPageGroupsByLostConversions, getTopPagesBySessionsWithErrors, computeFunnel, computeImpact, computeJourney, computePageComparison, and computePageGroupMetrics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Contentsquare?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Contentsquare in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Contentsquare requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Contentsquare is developed by Contentsquare. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
